summary.message: Twice a day, GitHub Actions collects new review data, incrementally builds financial and deal graphs, and publishes learned ranking only when holdout validation improves.

stages.name: Event classifier

evaluation.reason: Requires at least 1,000 reviewed training headlines and the locked 680-item attribution evaluation set.

stages.notes: The current 680-headline attribution set is held out from event-type training; this model uses only reviewed event labels.

stages.name: Entity resolution

evaluation.reason: Requires at least 500 reviewed training pairs and 100 separately held-out pairs.

stages.notes: Fuzzy candidate pairs are queued for human review; ambiguous entities are not merged automatically.

stages.name: Financial anomalies
stages.notes: Annual filings are collected incrementally and threshold flags remain unreviewed until labelled.

stages.name: Graph intelligence
stages.notes: Deal-party edges accumulate only when the extractor finds both parties; every edge keeps source links.

stages.name: Learned ranking
stages.notes: A time-ordered holdout gates promotion; the deployed model is not overwritten when the candidate fails validation.

ideas.suitable_for: Short-term savings or cash that may be needed soon
benefits: Simple way to diversify cash holdings
disadvantages: Returns can fall when interest rates decline
May not keep pace with inflation
Fund value, fees, liquidity and deposit protection vary by provider and country
ideas.example: Compare regulated funds in your country by fees, holdings, withdrawal terms and audited returns.

ideas.risk: Low to high, depending on issuer and term
ideas.suitable_for: Investors seeking scheduled interest or a defined maturity date
benefits: Short-term bills can have less price sensitivity than long bonds
disadvantages: Longer bonds can lose value when rates rise
Inflation and currency depreciation can reduce real returns
ideas.example: Compare sovereign credit quality, yield after fees/tax, currency and time to maturity.

ideas.suitable_for: Long-term goals where the investor can tolerate market declines
benefits: Can participate in long-term business growth
disadvantages: Prices can fall sharply and remain down for years
Fees, taxes and tracking error reduce returns
ideas.example: Compare regulated broad-market index funds or ETFs; check benchmark, holdings, costs and domicile.

ideas.suitable_for: Investors who can research a business and tolerate losing some or all of the investment
benefits: Company disclosures can support independent analysis
disadvantages: A strong company can still be an overpriced stock
Trading liquidity, governance and currency risks can be substantial
ideas.example: Review audited statements, debt, cash flow, valuation, governance, liquidity and downside scenarios.

ideas.risk: Low to high, depending on allocation
ideas.suitable_for: People who want diversified exposure managed under one mandate
benefits: Can reduce the need to rebalance manually
Fund mandate and holdings are usually published
disadvantages: A label such as 'balanced' does not guarantee low risk
ideas.example: Read the mandate, latest holdings, fees, drawdowns and redemption restrictions.

ranking_evaluation.promotion_rule: Promote only if holdout precision@top-20% beats alpha by at least 2 percentage points and Brier score beats the prevalence baseline.
